title: MSc Artificial Intelligence
summary: Advanced AI theory and applications, including image, video and time series methods.
academic: Good honours degree in computing or a related field with mathematical training; an alternative bachelor route requires two years of relevant industry experience.
extra: GRE and reference letters are optional. Degree equivalence and mathematical preparation require human review.
evidence_type: Author paraphrase of official university page

title: MSc Data Science
summary: Data preparation, analysis, visualisation and an interdisciplinary capstone across the data science lifecycle.
academic: Good honours degree in computing or a related field with mathematical training; an alternative bachelor route requires two years of relevant industry experience.
extra: GRE and reference letters are optional. Related disciplines and degree quality need individual review.
evidence_type: Author paraphrase of official university page

title: MSc Information Systems
summary: Information systems design, software infrastructure, human computer interaction and management of information services.
academic: Computing or IT-related bachelor degree, or a bachelor degree plus relevant employment; at least second class lower or equivalent. Internships do not count as employment.
extra: IELTS bands must each reach 6.0. Tests have a two-year validity. GRE and GMAT are not required.
evidence_type: Author paraphrase of official university page

title: MSc Data Science and Machine Learning
summary: Mathematics, statistics and computing underpin data modelling, optimisation and machine learning.
academic: Honours degree in quantitative science, engineering or computer science.
extra: IELTS validity is two years at application. The language rule also considers native language; unsupported exemption routes require university review.
evidence_type: Author paraphrase of official university page

title: Master of Computing General Track
summary: A computing conversion route for graduates from other disciplines who want to move into IT.
academic: Good honours degree or equivalent in any discipline; IT work experience is preferred.
extra: GRE or GMAT evidence is required; GATE may be an alternative for Indian university graduates. Test routes and equivalence must be checked manually.
evidence_type: Author paraphrase of official university page

title: Master of IT in Business
summary: Business and technology study with analytics, artificial intelligence and digital transformation pathways.
academic: Applicants from all degree backgrounds may apply. Two years of business or technology experience is preferred.
extra: GMAT, GRE or SMU test route applies, with selected local graduate exemptions. Admission interviews and test exemptions require manual review.
evidence_type: Author paraphrase of official university page

title: MEd Learning Sciences and Artificial Intelligence
summary: Learning sciences, classroom pedagogy, learning analytics and AI-supported educational design.
academic: Good bachelor degree or eligible FlexiMasters, plus a teaching qualification or at least one year of education work.
extra: The programme links to separate English requirements. This prototype has not encoded those requirements; always request human review.
evidence_type: Author paraphrase of official university page

title: MSc Data Science
summary: Statistical methods and computational tools for extracting information from complex data.
academic: Upper second-class equivalent in a quantitative discipline; university-level mathematics, statistics and programming. Overseas equivalence needs manual review.
extra: English Level 1. The 2026/27 application cycle is closed; check the next intake directly.
evidence_type: Author paraphrase of official university page

title: MSc Computer Science
summary: A computing conversion course for graduates who want to develop foundations in computer science.
academic: Degree in any subject with quantitative skills including algebra and calculus; existing computer science study may overlap. Country-specific grade equivalence requires review.
extra: IELTS evidence must be within 24 months of course start. Review suitability for applicants with an existing computing degree.
evidence_type: Author paraphrase of official university page

title: MSc Business Analytics and Management Science
summary: Quantitative analysis, optimisation and management science for business decisions.
academic: Upper second-class equivalent in a quantitative subject such as mathematics, engineering, economics, computing or quantitative business. Individual experience routes require review.
extra: The programme combines business analytics and management science. Confirm English evidence validity directly.
evidence_type: Author paraphrase of official university page

title: MSc Artificial Intelligence
summary: Advanced artificial intelligence with programming, mathematical foundations and intelligent systems.
academic: Upper second-class equivalent in an accepted related discipline, with programming and substantial university mathematics; competitive offers may require higher attainment.
extra: IELTS must be within two years on the first day of the course-start month. 2027/28 requirements were not yet published at this snapshot.
evidence_type: Author paraphrase of official university page
